name: asticore-engage
description: Asticore Engage - the Grace & Gatsby website and content portal, running on Next.js and Cloudflare Workers with D1 and R2.

scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" payload generate:importmap && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" payload generate:types && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" next build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:database && pnpm run deploy:app && pnpm run deploy:migrate && pnpm run deploy:seed
scripts.deploy:migrate: curl -sf -X POST https://gracengatsby.com/api/internal-migrate -H "x-seed-key: gracengatsby-seed" || echo 'Schema call failed (non-fatal) - check /api/internal-migrate manually.'
scripts.deploy:seed: curl -sf -X POST https://gracengatsby.com/api/internal-seed -H "x-seed-key: gracengatsby-seed" || echo 'Seed call failed (non-fatal) - check /api/internal-seed manually.'
scripts.deploy:database: wrangler d1 execute D1 --file=./src/migrations/sql/20260822_120859_fix_blocks_rels_tables_part1.sql --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote && wrangler d1 execute D1 --file=./src/migrations/sql/20260822_120859_fix_blocks_rels_tables_part2.sql --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote && wrangler d1 execute D1 --file=./src/migrations/sql/20260822_120859_fix_blocks_rels_tables_part3.sql --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote && wrangler d1 execute D1 --file=./src/migrations/sql/20260822_120859_fix_blocks_rels_tables_part4.sql --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote && wrangler d1 execute D1 --command 'PRAGMA optimize' --env=$CLOUDFLARE_ENV --remote
scripts.devsafe: rm -rf .next && rm -rf .open-next && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.generate:types: pnpm run generate:types:cloudflare && pnpm run generate:types:engage
scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.db:local: pnpm run prepare:engine-tables && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore pnpm run cms migrate

PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`
